resource_risks.description: Monaco creates editor and model resources for source preview and runtime editing.
resource_risks.mitigation: @monaco-editor/react owns editor lifecycle and the implementation avoids manual model creation or retained global editor references.
evidence: workspace-monitor/components/MonitorShell.tsx uses MonacoEditor without manual createModel calls
Browser verification showed one mounted .monaco-editor in Source viewer

resource_risks.description: Clipboard access can fail in restricted browser contexts.
resource_risks.mitigation: Copy action tries navigator.clipboard.writeText first and then a temporary textarea fallback; failures show a bounded notice instead of throwing.
evidence: Browser verification showed bounded Clipboard unavailable notice under automation permissions

resource_risks.description: The existing static preview server remains available for user review.
resource_risks.mitigation: No new preview server was started; the existing 127.0.0.1:3018 server serves the latest static build.
resource_risks.rationale: The server is intentionally retained as the user-facing preview surface.

evidence: No manual monaco.editor.createModel or global editor storage added
Preview URL remains available for user review: http://127.0.0.1:3018/
lifecycle_checks.rationale: The server is intentionally retained for the delivered preview URL.

measurement_checks.threshold: At least one .monaco-editor, nonzero shell size, no horizontal overflow.
evidence: Source tab: monacoEditors=1, shellRect height=440 width=541, horizontalOverflow=false

notes: Browser automation did not grant clipboard permission, so copy success could not be proven in Browser; graceful fallback notice was verified.
